info.description: AgentPal: financial infrastructure for EXTERNAL AI agents. The /v1 developer API registers agents (one-time API keys), configures virtual wallets (a VIRTUAL ALLOWANCE derived from the ledger, never money), grants permissions, and accepts payment requests that are validated, budget-checked and risk-assessed, then need an authenticated owner approval bound to the exact terms. Execution is PayPal SANDBOX only. Errors are `{"error": "<code>"}`. Development preview: not production-ready. The legacy risk-assessment endpoints are documented as well.
info.title: AgentPal API
